::: {#def-conjugate-prior}
#### Conjugate prior

A family $\mathcal{F}$ of prior distributions is **conjugate** to a likelihood
if, for every prior $\p(\param)$ in the family and every possible data set $\vy$,
the [posterior](#def-posterior) is also in the family:

$$\p(\param) \in \mathcal{F} \implies \p(\param \mid \vy) \in \mathcal{F}.$$

Source: @wikipedia_conjugate_prior.
:::
